note: All cohorts are shipped in one file so that fetching it reveals nothing about the caller. The client selects its own cohort locally.

all.metric: share of merged agent PRs without a review record
all.source: AIDev (huggingface hao-li/AIDev), agent PRs 2024-12..2025-07, repositories with >=5 merged agent PRs
all.freshness: Derived from public data through 2025-07. It becomes more current as submissions accumulate.
all.shape_warning: Bimodal. Rank carries little information near the ends; use regime shares.
all.trend_note: Not published for the combined cohort. The apparent movement (0.31 to 0.85) is almost entirely a composition shift: agent PRs arriving under human accounts grew rapidly from 2025-05. Within-type trends are published instead.
all.cohort_rule: Repositories are assigned to exactly one cohort by the posting-identity type that accounts for more than 50% of their merged agent PRs. A repository is never counted in two cohorts.
all.mass_note: Share of the cohort falling in each 0.05-wide cell. Used to report how many repositories sit at the caller's value.
